_comment: Hand corrections to gate_role, applied after the LLM triage that sets it. A gate here was triaged as a `filter` with a machine-readable value_spec, which means it can DISQUALIFY a founder and remove the fund from their brief silently -- but its own wording does not state a requirement. Found by looking for rules whose text hedges about whether they apply at all ('typically', 'predominantly', 'may also'), then reading each one. The hedging was a way to FIND these; it is deliberately NOT a rule in the pipeline, because a word-matching filter would be exactly the enumerated register this repo forbids and would catch rules that hedge a threshold while stating a real requirement.
_why_a_file: encode_gates.py writes gate_role directly from a paid triage pass, so a manual UPDATE would be silently reverted the next time triage runs. This is reapplied after it. Gates whose requirement is a COMPATIBILITY FINDING about aid already granted belong here too: verbatim and correctly attributed, but the wrong KIND of statement for a column a founder reads as a test they can pass.
_roles: programme_fact = true of the instrument, says nothing about who qualifies. vague = a real condition we cannot turn into a test. Neither can decide a verdict; both still show on the row.

overrides.requirement: The Fund takes minority equity stakes, typically around 10% but can go higher.
overrides.why: Describes what the instrument does with its money, not a test the founder passes or fails. As a filter it could exclude a founder for the Fund's own investment policy.

overrides.requirement: Growth equity target companies typically already have significant, often international revenue.
overrides.why: A description of who the fund has tended to back, not a stated threshold. Blocking a company for being below a 'typical' revenue nobody published is the overclaim this corpus exists to avoid.

overrides.requirement: Venture capital investments require companies with strong potential for growth.
overrides.why: A real intention, but 'strong potential' is not checkable against any intake answer. Kept as information; it must not decide a verdict.

overrides.requirement: The EU guarantee may also cover funding or guarantees extended by an implementing partner.
overrides.why: 'May also cover' widens the guarantee's scope. It is a permission, and encoding a permission as a filter inverts it into a restriction.

overrides.requirement: Undertakings in difficulty are excluded from the scheme, except young companies within their first years.
overrides.why: THE WORST OF THE SEVEN. The rule carries an exception for young companies and the value_spec does not encode it, so as a filter it blocks precisely the founders the exception protects -- an early-stage company with accumulated losses, which is most of them. Downgraded until the exception can be encoded rather than dropped.

overrides.requirement: Only pre-selected undertakings listed in the participating Member States' notification and forming part of the Hy2Infra individual projects are eligible aid beneficiaries.
overrides.why: A compatibility FINDING about aid already granted to a named beneficiary list, not a condition an applicant can satisfy. Its quote -- 'These measures are granted only to the aid beneficiaries chosen by the participating Member States and listed in section 2.4.2 ... It is not available to all undertakings' -- is the Commission establishing SELECTIVITY under Article 107(1), a test applied to the measure by the assessor, about companies already chosen. It can never be true-or-false OF AN APPLICANT, which is what a filter must be. As a filter it would disqualify every founder who reads it, silently, for not already having been chosen.

overrides.requirement: Only the specific companies listed as Direct Participants (selected via national open and transparent calls) are eligible aid beneficiaries under the notified IPCEI Batteries measures.
overrides.why: The same selectivity finding, and the source of the sentence retracted from eligibility_text on 2026-08-07: 'The Member States only grant support to the beneficiaries listed section 2.2.6 and the funding is not available to all undertakings in a comparable situation.' The retraction removed it from the column a founder reads as 'who may apply' and left it encoded as a filter, which is the same claim in a place that can decide a verdict.

overrides.requirement: Only the listed direct participants established in the six participating Member States (Slovakia, Hungary, France, Italy, Belgium, Spain) are eligible beneficiaries of the notified aid measures under the IPCEI Med4Cure.
overrides.why: The worst of the four: llm_2pass, so ASSERTABLE, and resolved onto entityCountries, so evaluable -- it could have decided a verdict against a founder in the wrong country. It also fails on pertinence independently of its kind: the quote is 'This section briefly describes the 14 direct participants involved in the IPCEI Med4Cure', a section header, which does not state the requirement written above it.

overrides.requirement: Support is only granted to the specific beneficiaries listed in the decision, not open to all undertakings in a comparable situation.
overrides.why: Listed so the population is complete and a reader can see the fourth instance. It already carries the inert role and needs no change; it is the same sentence as ipcei_batteries/G1-02, which is how the pattern was found.

_kept_as_filters: satr_de_rnd/g1_nexus_works_in_germany_dns (work must generally be carried out in Germany) and satr_de_rnd/g3_own_contribution_sicherheit (an appropriate own contribution is required) hedge a THRESHOLD, not whether the rule applies. Both are real conditions of the scheme and continue to filter. Note both are regime-level rules extracted from one scheme's document, which is the separate open item.
